page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is a high-frequency server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at 3.1 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. Operating under a KVM hypervisor, the server provides 64 dedicated vCPUs paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, delivering a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU. The configuration contains zero integrated GPUs and no local disk storage, requiring network-attached storage for operating system and persistent data needs. Network performance is anchored by a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth allocation, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned.

The primary architectural tradeoff of the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is its complete reliance on external network storage for disk operations, as local NVMe or SSD capacity is absent. From a qualitative cost-efficiency standpoint, the server maximizes processing density by offering 64 high-clock-speed vCPUs without forcing users to pay for bundled local storage or specialized acceleration hardware. This hardware profile makes the instance effective for compute-bound tasks requiring high frequency, including enterprise application servers, continuous integration build pipelines, batch processing engines, and general-purpose workloads.
